objective: Repair live Android mentor teaching-report access and CCP5 lesson selection, with secure audited mentor grants and account-scoped lesson completion receipts; prepare a strictly gated production Android OTA candidate without deploying.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: current GitHub main SOURCE COMMIT 536741f8d97fc9dec91503c89f1c1160e5987ce0 and its app.config.js were read and compared against this exact main-derived RC on 2026-11-21. Configured Android package org.mzbministry.buklod, EAS project 23dad7d0-389a-406e-8dec-08965dab85d8, runtimeVersion 1.3.2; release workflow is protected by exact marker/RC gates. Production Supabase was inspected read-only and still has zero active mentor grants and the original mentor lesson RPC. This is source/config/database-state evidence ONLY; THE LIVE INSTALLED APK ARTIFACT, EXPO PRODUCTION UPDATE ID AND ON-DEVICE RUNTIME HAVE NOT BEEN VERIFIED. These must be independently attested before any production OTA publication.
chosenApproach: Forward-port only seven isolated DEV paths plus a security-hardening trigger, one SQL contract and one scope manifest to a fresh main-based RC hold. Do not merge 139 unrelated DEV commits, deploy SQL to production, mutate identity permissions or release OTA until isolated DB/CI/Android gates pass.
selectionRationale: The source branch is diverged from main. Mentor catalog RPC currently returns [] for all users because there are no active mentor capabilities, and the Admin relationship editor can assign learners without granting mentor capability. An audited, explicitly reviewed admin-only capability path preserves protected official identity and avoids accidental BP awards.
alternativeApproaches: Merge divergent Season 2 DEV branch directly to production (rejected: hundreds of unrelated unverified changes).
Automatically reactivate five inactive mentor capability records (rejected: unclear revocation history, least privilege).
Publish JS-only OTA before SQL dependency (rejected: admin activation fails and source/back-end diverge).
preserveBehaviors: No live production DB/OTA/APK changes before release gate.
Preserve all historical mentor assignments and teaching reports; no backfill/automatic BP awards.
Preserve private photo storage, verified learner roster, and idempotent report RPC.
Maintain system-admin protections and all app-wide AdMob navigation and compact-spacing gates.
No new native dependencies or changes to app.config.js, eas.json, package-lock.json.
acceptanceChecks: Main-isolated source diff includes only declared paths and native config is unchanged.
Node mentor tests, existing Points R2 tests, full TypeScript and release suites pass in CI.
Isolated SQL migrations execute and database test passes, including real authenticated/RLS, system-admin, protected-account, idempotency and concurrency scenarios.
Staging Android RC confirms learner receipt, CCP5 lesson 2 selection and private evidence report, weak network and duplicate-request recovery.
Signed installed production APK runtime/channel/project and update source SHA verified; AdMob first view and instant navigation unchanged.
Apply reviewed DB schema before OTA, freeze exact RC and verify publication ID plus post-release device behavior.
releaseTarget: org.mzbministry.buklod / production Android OTA / configured runtime 1.3.2; actual installed runtime verification required
